description.value: Melriches Coffee House is an independent cafe that has served Vancouver's West End neighbourhood since 1997, deliberately positioning itself as a community alternative to chain coffee shops with mismatched furniture and a weekly neighbour meet-up table by the window. It offers coffee, teas, pastries, soups, and sandwiches in a wheelchair-accessible indoor setting on Davie Street near Bute. The cafe's community-first ethos — prompt cards on the counter to help strangers start conversations — sets it apart from more transactional coffee stops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The WordPress website (last updated December 2010) confirms the address (1244 Davie St, Vancouver, BC) and phone (+1 604 689 5282), both matching OSM tags exactly. Wi-Fi is supported by OSM tag internet_access=wlan and corroborated by the website's 'Our Story' page referencing wi-fi access as a feature the cafe added over time. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, leaving all required criteria unconfirmable; the website is approximately 15 years stale and cannot be relied upon for current amenity details.
concerns: Website (WordPress blog) has not been updated since December 2010 — content is approximately 15 years stale and cannot be relied upon for current amenity information.
Discovered URL has only medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags; business name and address in the content do match OSM, supporting the association.

Field verification or a current web presence would be needed before a confident include decision.
